title: Sunday Crispy Pork Roast
description: A classic British dish with a deliciously crispy exterior and a tender interior, perfect for a Sunday roast. This gluten-free recipe is a must-try for any pork lover.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue roasting for 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Toss the carrots and potatoes with a little bit of olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Spread them out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
Serve the pork with the roasted vegetables and enjoy!
